title: DiscordSettings
description: Shape contract for the serialised DiscordSettings model.

enabled.description: Whether the Discord bot is enabled

token.description: Discord bot token (or env var reference)

allowed_user_id.description: Discord user ID authorized to use the bot

allowed_channel_ids.description: Optional allowlist of Discord channel IDs

mention_only.description: Whether guild messages must mention the bot

system_prompt.description: Custom system prompt for Discord conversations
